issues.claim_quote: The excerpts show no meaningful contextual differences in participant experience.

evidence.quote: Income reduced, because most people were at home, schools were closed, some people also ran away from town and came back to the village. So we were having breakfast, lunch, supper and people were not going to work. You could go for a short time, sometimes you could go in the morning and it is in the evening that customers were available, there was no money
I am in support of that.
